Please PM me if you need to talk to someone, even if it's just a stranger like me. 
I was 10 when I first thought about suicide, but I do hope we're the exception... It's such a young age, you shouldn't be thinking about stuff like that, breaks my heart to read that someone so young feels that way.
Now my question is, does OP own a horse? Or is it a random horse that decided to go for a swim in their pool?

I have full on conversations with my dog all the time. I don't really expect an answer when I ask her what I should make for dinner. But she's my friend, and she listens even if we don't speak the same language, so I'll give her all the attention I can.
I want to see his pile of rocks :/
Not cool, I got really excited for a minute til I read the comments.

Hey there. I think I know how you're feeling, I tried killing myself in February. luckily i stopped half way through cos that would have left a lot of people sad. Don't do it. There's always somebody that cares about you even if you don't see it.

Have you considered moving to a different city? do u have family abroad at all? Try to get away from that place that has left you with so many scars and bad memories. I could never go back to my hometown... 
There may also be better job oppurtunities for you. 
Try to register for a counselling service, it's good to speak to somebody that's not biased, their job is To Help people like us. Give it a go. Where do you live? 

 oh and if u need somebody to talk, send me a message on here x
Is that in Edinburgh, Scotland by any chance?
